_notes: Master world palette for Vesperholm tilesets. Every area's tile set derives its --palette from here so the whole world reads as one cohesive place (see docs/world/atlas.md and the generate-sprite-sheet tileset flow). The 8 brand anchors come from src/game/config.ts; the extras are derived neutrals/shades for tile art (wood, soil, stone, sand, aurora). Keep tile sets to ~10-14 flat colours drawn from this set plus the area's 1-2 accents.

tinderwick.palette: blue-hour coastal village: bone-cream walls, warm fire-orange candlelight, deepBlue sea, grass verges, soil paths, ink outlines

dimglass_coast.palette: tidal cliff route: deepBlue water with diamond-cyan foam, ink rocks, grass tufts, sand, dim night sky

pearlmoor_quay.palette: moonlit port: wet bone boardwalk, water glints, deepBlue depths, brass-warm lamp dots, big cyan moon

lowleaf_hollow.palette: bioluminescent fern forest: grass and grass-dark foliage shot through with diamond glowmoss, deep ink shadow, dim-green dark

cinderhead_mine.palette: gem mine: ink-black tunnels, stone and stone-dark rock, veins of diamond crystal, fire lamp pools, soil rubble

galehigh_terraces.palette: windy cliff farms: grass terraces, fire-orange sunset bleeding into deepBlue, bone clouds, diamond updraft motes

pale_vault_glacier.palette: aurora ice field: deepBlue ice, bone snow, pale aurora green-cyan ribbons, diamond highlights, ink crevasses

sunken_solarium.palette: flooded sun-garden ruin: bone columns, fire stored-daylight glows under water-blue, grass overgrowth, deepBlue depths

nightreach_observatory.palette: hilltop star-temple: bone domes, deepBlue stone, brass, the densest diamond starfield in the game, ink night

coldfog_marches.palette: blighted wetland: desaturated muted blues, snuffed grey lanterns, ink mist swallowing colour, dull grass

vesper_crossroads.palette: cosy lantern-lit waystation: bone inn, warm fire windows, grass, soil paths, diamond lamp glints, deepBlue dusk

umbral_spire.palette: central dark mountain: black basalt (ink, stone-dark), null-lantern anti-light, faint diamond Skyweave glow above

dawnstead.palette: first-sunrise town: Tinderwick flooded with fire-orange and bone daylight, warm shadows, grass, open bright sky
